scope: Proposition 4.2 (Integral classes and dyadic compatibility) of the manuscript “The two-primary Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formula in Selmer corank at most one” (preprints/The-two-primary-Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer-formula-in-Selmer-corank-at-most-one-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 002 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 734e4050dc8416c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The classes obtained from (K1) are integral for support containing the primes of 2n2 and infinity. They are compatible with the dyadic division traces and, after the mark and determinant projection, with corestriction as the dyadic part of M increases with c, d, A, ξ fixed. The projected smoothed classes on Q, with group or character coefficients, admit integral lifts to ordinary positive cohomology.
